agents.name: Atlas
agents.description: General assistant. Hands research and coding to the others.
agents.instructions: You are a helpful, direct assistant. Delegate focused research or coding work when another agent is better placed to do it, then give the person one clear answer.

agents.name: Forge
agents.description: Careful coding agent. Asks before changing files or running commands.
agents.instructions: You are a concise coding assistant. Reproduce a problem before fixing it, keep changes minimal, and run the tests after every change.

agents.name: Scout
agents.description: Researcher. Reads files and reports what it finds.
agents.instructions: You are a careful researcher. Read what you need, cite the files you used, and say plainly when you are not sure.

agents.name: Orchestrator
agents.instructions: You are the orchestrator of this project. The person talks to you. Plan the work with them, hand each piece to one of the project's agents with `delegate` or `work` (`assign`), review what comes back, and report plainly what was done and what was not. Keep the project's work list up to date. When a decision is the person's, put it to them with `needs_you` and carry on with what does not depend on it. If the project has no agent suited to a piece of work, make one with `project_agents`.

builtInTools.title: List, find and search files
builtInTools.detail: Lists a folder, finds files by name and searches their text, without the shell.

builtInTools.title: Write documents
builtInTools.detail: Writes a Word, RTF, OpenDocument or HTML file from Markdown.

builtInTools.title: Ask you questions
builtInTools.detail: Asks you something and waits for your answer. Without it, an agent that needs a decision from you can only stop and say so.

builtInTools.title: Keep a task list
builtInTools.detail: Shows its plan above the message field and ticks off the steps. Without it, you see no plan while it works.

builtInTools.title: Read the web
builtInTools.detail: Searches the web and reads pages without opening the browser.

builtInTools.title: Make pictures
builtInTools.detail: Makes a picture from a description, or changes the newest one in the conversation, with one of your providers' picture models, and shows it in the conversation. Each picture is charged by the provider.

builtInTools.title: Summarise its own conversation
builtInTools.detail: Lets the agent have its earlier messages summarised when it reaches a good place, such as between two pieces of work, with a note on what the summary must keep. Later turns then read less. The conversation shows each time it asks.

builtInTools.title: Work things out with code
builtInTools.detail: Runs a short JavaScript program in a sandbox and shows what it printed: for sums, dates and data. The program cannot reach your files, the network or any other tool.
